description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing SHA1-HMAC cryptographic functions for Infineon Technologies hardware, including key setting, transformation, initialization, update, and final digest computation.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, used during SHA1-HMAC transformation.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets the SHA1 HMAC key, limited to 64 bytes.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads SHA1 HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_update
methods.description: Performs on-the-fly SHA1 HMAC computation with input data.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final
methods.description: Computes the final SHA1 HMAC digest.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1_hmac
methods.description: Registers the SHA1 HMAC driver with the kernel crypto API.
